Low-level Nim bindings for JavaScriptCore, Apple's JavaScript engine.

C names are preserved verbatim so upstream code stays greppable. Uses the JavaScriptCore framework on macOS.

Basic example:

import javascriptcore

withGlobalContext(ctx):
  var ex: JSValueRef = nil
  let res = evalScript(ctx, "1 + 2", exception = ex)
  assert ex == nil
  var ex2: JSValueRef = nil
  assert JSValueToNumber(ctx, res, addr ex2) == 3.0

The raw API (JSEvaluateScript, JSObjectMakeFunctionWithCallback, ...) returns exactly what C returns, including nil on failure: always check the exception out-param. helpers adds newJSString, $, evalScript and withGlobalContext on top.

Define jscStatic (or jscNoPkgConfig) to skip the automatic link flags and supply your own. Define jscStaticLib with the path to a custom static libjavascriptcore archive to link it directly (jscIncludeDir optionally points at its headers).

Imports

javascriptcore/jsbase, javascriptcore/jsstringref, javascriptcore/jscontextref, javascriptcore/jsvalueref, javascriptcore/jsobjectref, javascriptcore/jstypedarray, javascriptcore/helpers

Consts

jscIncludeDir {.strdefine.} = ""
Extra C include dir for the JavaScriptCore headers, e.g. -d:jscIncludeDir=/opt/jsc/include. Applies in every link mode. 
jscStaticLib {.strdefine.} = ""
Path to a custom static JavaScriptCore archive, e.g. -d:jscStaticLib=/opt/jsc/lib/libjavascriptcore.a. Takes precedence over every automatic link mode below. Extra native dependencies of your build (ICU, etc.) still need their own --passL.
